Dear {{ doc.applicant_name }},

With reference to your application and the subsequent discussions with us, we are pleased to offer you employment with {{ doc.company }}, subject to the following terms and conditions contained in this Offer Letter.

1. EFFECTIVE DATE : Your appointment will be effective {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.offer_date) }} {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.custom_joining_date) }}

2. JOB TITLE : You are being appointed to the position of {{ doc.designation }}.

3. CADRE As per the Company's Cadre Structure and HR Policy, you will be placed in {{ doc.custom_cadre or "E-1" }} Cadre, unless otherwise communicated in writing by the Company.

4. REPORTING : You shall report to {{ doc.custom_reporting_manager or "the Manager assigned by the Company" }}. The Company reserves the right to change your Reporting Manager, department, reporting structure, or organizational hierarchy at any time based on business requirements.

5. COMPENSATION : Your compensation, salary structure, allowances, statutory benefits, deductions, and Cost to Company (CTC) are detailed in Annexure – I, which forms an integral part of this Offer Letter.

The compensation payable to you shall be subject to applicable statutory deductions, including but not limited to Income Tax (TDS), Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Professional Tax, and any other deductions required under applicable laws or Company policy.

The Company reserves the right to review, revise, restructure, or modify your compensation and benefits from time to time based on your performance, Company policy, business requirements, and statutory provisions.

6. CONDITIONS OF HIRE : This Offer of Employment is conditional upon the successful completion of your background verification, reference verification, educational qualification verification, employment history verification, identity verification, and any other checks deemed necessary by the Company.

By accepting this Offer Letter, you expressly authorize {{ doc.company }} or its authorized representatives to verify your credentials and to contact your previous employers, educational institutions, references, government authorities, or any other relevant agencies for conducting background and reference verification.

If any information provided by you is found to be false, misleading, incomplete, or materially incorrect, or if the background verification is found to be unsatisfactory, the Company reserves the right to withdraw this Offer or terminate your employment without any liability.

7. PROBATION / CONFIRMATION / PERFORMANCE REVIEW : You shall be on probation for a period of three (3) months from your date of joining. Upon satisfactory completion of the probation period, your employment shall be deemed confirmed automatically unless the Company communicates, in writing, an extension of the probation period or any other decision regarding your employment.

Your performance shall be reviewed periodically during the probation period. Thereafter, your first formal Performance Review shall normally be conducted upon the successful completion of one (1) year from your date of appointment and subsequently in accordance with the Company's Performance Management Policy.

8. LOCATION AND TRANSFER : Your initial place of posting shall be as communicated by the Company. However, during the course of your employment, you shall be liable to be transferred, deputed, or assigned to any office, branch, plant, project site, customer location, subsidiary, associate company, joint venture, or any other business unit of {{ doc.company }} or its group companies, whether existing now or established/acquired in the future, based on the Company's business requirements and at the sole discretion of the Management.

Upon such transfer, deputation, or reassignment, you shall faithfully perform the duties assigned to you at the new location, department, role, or business unit and shall comply with all policies, procedures, service rules, reporting structures, and operational requirements applicable to that location or assignment.

The Company reserves the right to change your designation, reporting manager, department, work location, role, responsibilities, competency, or place of work as may be required in the interest of the business. In such cases, the compensation, allowances, benefits, entitlements, working conditions, service rules, and other employment terms applicable to the new assignment or location shall become binding upon you, unless otherwise communicated in writing by the Company.

9. HOURS OF WORK & HOLIDAYS : Your working hours, weekly offs, holidays, leave entitlements, and attendance requirements shall be governed by the Company's policies, rules, and operational requirements as amended from time to time.

As the Company operates in a dynamic business environment, you may be required to work in different shifts, staggered working hours, rotational schedules, overtime (where applicable), or on holidays as per business requirements and applicable laws. You shall comply with the duty timings and work schedules assigned by the Company from time to time.

10. RETIREMENT AGE : The normal age of retirement from the services of {{ doc.company }} shall be 60 (Sixty) years, unless otherwise specified by the Company or required under applicable law.

Your employment with the Company shall automatically cease on the last working day of the month in which you attain the retirement age of 60 (Sixty) years, unless your employment is specifically extended by the Company through a written communication.

11. TERMINATION OF EMPLOYMENT :

  1. During the probation period, either the Employee or the Company may terminate this employment by giving three (3) months' written notice to the other party or by complying with the applicable Company policy in force at that time.
  2. As per the Company's policy, the Relieving Letter, Experience Certificate, and other separation documents shall be issued only after the successful completion of all exit formalities, return of Company assets, and completion of the applicable notice period. The Company may, at its sole discretion, accept full or partial payment in lieu of the notice period, subject to Company policy.
  3. Where an early relieving is approved by the Company upon the Employee's request, the salary equivalent to the unserved portion of the notice period shall be recovered from the Employee's Full & Final Settlement or otherwise, in accordance with the Company's policy.
  4. Notwithstanding anything contained herein, the Company reserves the right to terminate your employment with immediate effect, without notice or payment in lieu thereof, if in the reasonable opinion of the Company you are found guilty of misconduct, fraud, dishonesty, theft, breach of trust, misrepresentation, violation of the Company's Code of Conduct, Confidentiality Agreement, Company policies, statutory requirements, or for refusal to comply with any lawful and reasonable instructions issued by your Reporting Manager or authorized Company representative.

12. ON SEPARATION :

  1. Upon your resignation or termination of your employment for any reason, you shall immediately return to the Company all property belonging to the Company, including but not limited to laptops, mobile phones, ID cards, access cards, keys, tools, accessories, documents, drawings, formulae, specifications, manuals, records, confidential information, software, storage devices, books, and any other assets or materials in your possession, custody, or control.
  2. Before your Full & Final Settlement is processed, you shall obtain a No Due / Clearance Certificate from all concerned departments, including but not limited to HR, Administration, IT, Finance, Stores, and your Reporting Manager. Any outstanding dues or unreturned Company property may be recovered from your final settlement, as permitted by applicable law.
  3. The Company reserves the right to withhold the Relieving Letter, Experience Certificate, Full & Final Settlement, or any other separation benefits until all Company assets have been returned and all clearance formalities have been successfully completed.
  4. You authorize the Company to verify your employment details and, where legally permissible, share information relating to your employment, performance, conduct, disciplinary records, and reason for separation with any future or prospective employer as part of their background verification or reference check process.

13. GENERAL CONDITIONS

  1. You shall work under the supervision of your Reporting Manager or any other officer authorized by the Company from time to time. You are expected to perform your duties diligently, honestly, and faithfully, and to carry out all lawful instructions assigned by your superiors to the best of your skills and abilities.
  2. You shall lose your lien on employment if you remain absent from duty without prior approval or sanctioned leave for a continuous period exceeding ten (10) days, unless otherwise decided by the Management.
  3. You shall not engage, directly or indirectly, in any business, trade, profession, consultancy, employment, or occupation, whether part-time, full-time, honorary, or for remuneration, without obtaining prior written approval from the Company.
  4. You confirm that you have fully disclosed to the Company all your existing business interests or engagements, whether or not they conflict with the Company's business. You further agree to promptly disclose any such interest that may arise during your employment.
  5. During the tenure of your employment, you shall not be personally or indirectly associated with, interested in, or connected with any business or undertaking that may conflict with the interests of the Company.
  6. You shall indemnify and keep indemnified the Company against any claims, demands, damages, losses, costs, expenses, or liabilities arising out of your breach, negligence, misconduct, default, or failure to comply with the terms and conditions of your employment.
  7. By accepting this Offer Letter, you represent and warrant that joining the Company does not violate any agreement, confidentiality obligation, non-compete obligation, or other contractual commitment with your previous employer or any third party.
  8. The Company may sponsor you for training, certification programs, or assignments within India or abroad. The Company may require you to execute a separate Training Bond or Service Agreement specifying the minimum service period after such training. In case of voluntary resignation before completion of the agreed service period, you may be liable to compensate the Company in accordance with the applicable agreement.
  9. You are expected to maintain a professional appearance and adhere to the Company's dress code, including business attire, smart casuals, safety equipment, or uniforms, as prescribed by Company policy from time to time.
  10. Where considered necessary, the Company may require you to undergo a medical examination during your employment. Continuation of your employment shall be subject to you being declared medically fit by a medical practitioner nominated by the Company.
  11. The terms of your employment, including your compensation and benefits, are strictly confidential. You shall not discuss or disclose your salary or employment terms to any person except the Human Resources Department or your Reporting Manager where officially required.
  12. You shall be solely responsible for your personal income tax obligations. Wherever required under applicable laws, the Company shall deduct Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) or any other statutory deductions from your salary and deposit the same with the appropriate government authorities.
  13. You shall notify the Human Resources Department in writing of any change in your residential address, contact number, marital status, nominee details, bank account, emergency contact, or any other personal information within three (3) working days of such change.

14. CONFIDENTIALITY

It is understood and agreed that all information, records, documents, technical data, business strategies, customer information, financial information, trade secrets, and any other confidential or proprietary information obtained by you during the course of your employment with CALCO POLY TECHNIK PVT. LTD. shall be treated as strictly confidential.

You shall not, either during your employment or after cessation of your employment, directly or indirectly disclose, publish, copy, reproduce, or use such confidential information for any purpose other than the performance of your official duties, unless specifically authorized in writing by the Company.

  • Any unauthorized disclosure of confidential information during the course of your employment shall constitute misconduct and may result in disciplinary action, including termination of employment.
  • Any unauthorized disclosure after the termination of your employment shall render you liable for civil and/or criminal proceedings as permitted under applicable laws.

You shall be required to sign the Company's Confidentiality Agreement (Non-Disclosure Agreement) at the time of joining, which shall form an integral part of your Contract of Employment.

15. AMENDMENTS

The Company reserves the absolute right to amend, modify, withdraw, replace, or revise any of the employment terms, benefits, compensation structure, policies, procedures, service rules, or other conditions of employment as may be considered necessary from time to time in accordance with business requirements and applicable laws.

All rules, regulations, policies, manuals, circulars, and guidelines issued by the Company from time to time shall automatically become applicable to you and shall form an integral part of your employment terms. You shall be bound to comply with and abide by such amendments, policies, and regulations throughout your employment with the Company.

16. NOTICES

All notices, requests, consents, and other communications required or permitted under this Offer Letter shall be made in writing and shall be deemed to have been duly given if delivered personally or sent by registered post, courier, or any other legally accepted mode of communication to the addresses mentioned below or to such other address as either party may notify in writing from time to time.

  1. If to the Employee: At the residential address provided by the Employee and updated with the Company from time to time.
  2. If to the Company: At its registered/corporate office address:

    CALCO POLY TECHNIK PVT. LTD.
    Khasra No. 22/24/2, 25/4/2,
    Tehsil Rai, Village Liwaspur,
    Sonipat, Haryana – 131021.

Either party may change its correspondence address by providing prior written notice to the other party. Any notice sent to the last recorded address shall be deemed to have been duly served.

17. CODE OF CONDUCT

Calco Poly Technik Pvt. Ltd. prides itself on maintaining the highest standards of ethical conduct in all its dealings with employees, customers, suppliers, business associates, and government authorities.

As a condition of your employment, you shall comply with the Company's Code of Conduct, Confidentiality Agreement, and all other policies, rules, regulations, and procedures that may be issued, amended, or updated by the Company from time to time.

You are expected to conduct yourself with honesty, integrity, professionalism, and respect while performing your duties. Any violation of the Company's Code of Conduct, confidentiality obligations, or other applicable policies may result in disciplinary action, including termination of employment, in accordance with the Company's policies and applicable laws.

18. JOINING DETAILS

On your date of joining, you will report for duty at the following address. Reporting time is 09:30 AM.

Location:
Khasra No. 22/24/2, 25/4/2,
Tehsil Rai, Village Liwaspur,
Sonipat, Haryana - 131021

On your joining day, please ensure that you bring the originals along with one set of self-attested photocopies of the following documents for completing the joining formalities:

  1. Proof of Age – SSC Certificate or School Leaving Certificate.
  2. Relieving Certificate / Service Certificate from your previous employer.
  3. Educational Certificates along with all mark sheets.
  4. Last Salary Slip / Pay Slip and Appointment Letter of your previous organization.
  5. Identity Proof – PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Passport or Voter Identity Card.
  6. Three (3) recent passport-size colour photographs.

document.name: Job Opening Delay Report
document.query:
SELECT
    jo.name AS "Job Opening:Link/Job Opening:180",
    jo.staffing_plan AS "Staffing Plan:Data:180",
    jo.job_title AS "Job Title:Data:180",
    jr.name AS "Job Requisition:Link/Job Requisition:180",
    jr.designation AS "Designation:Data:150",
    jr.department AS "Department:Data:150",
    jr.expected_by AS "Expected By:Date:110",
    jo.closed_on AS "Closed On:Date:110",

    DATEDIFF(
        jo.closed_on,
        jr.expected_by
    ) AS "Delay Days:Int:100"

FROM
    `tabJob Opening` jo

LEFT JOIN
    `tabJob Requisition` jr
    ON jr.designation = jo.job_title
    AND jr.department = jo.department

WHERE
    jo.closed_on IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY
    jo.closed_on DESC;

document.script:
# ============================================================ # PURCHASE RETURN AUTOMATION # Purchase Receipt -> Quality Inspection -> RM TC PDF -> Email # # Runs ONLY when Purchase Receipt is a Return. # Event: After Submit # ============================================================ # ------------------------------------------------------------ # 1. RUN ONLY FOR PURCHASE RETURN # ------------------------------------------------------------ if doc.is_return: # -------------------------------------------------------- # 2. INTERNAL EMAIL RECIPIENTS # -------------------------------------------------------- recipients = [ "mis.1@calco.in", "varun.gupta@calco.in" ] # -------------------------------------------------------- # 3. GET SUPPLIER EMAIL # -------------------------------------------------------- supplier_email = frappe.db.get_value( "Supplier", doc.supplier, "email_id" ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 4. STOP IF SUPPLIER EMAIL IS MISSING # -------------------------------------------------------- if not supplier_email: frappe.throw( "Supplier Email ID is not available for Supplier: " + str(doc.supplier) ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 5. ADD SUPPLIER EMAIL # -------------------------------------------------------- if supplier_email not in recipients: recipients.append( supplier_email ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 6. FIND QUALITY INSPECTIONS # -------------------------------------------------------- quality_inspections = [] for item in doc.items: if item.quality_inspection: if item.quality_inspection not in quality_inspections: quality_inspections.append( item.quality_inspection ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 7. STOP IF NO QUALITY INSPECTION # -------------------------------------------------------- if not quality_inspections: frappe.throw( "No Quality Inspection found in this Purchase Return." ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 8. PREPARE PDF ATTACHMENTS # -------------------------------------------------------- attachments = [] qi_names = [] # -------------------------------------------------------- # 9. GENERATE RM TC PDF FOR EVERY QUALITY INSPECTION # -------------------------------------------------------- for qi_name in quality_inspections: qi = frappe.get_doc( "Quality Inspection", qi_name ) qi_names.append( qi.name ) # ---------------------------------------------------- # Generate RM TC PDF # ---------------------------------------------------- pdf = frappe.get_print( "Quality Inspection", qi.name, print_format="RM TC", as_pdf=True ) # ---------------------------------------------------- # Add PDF Attachment # ---------------------------------------------------- attachments.append( { "fname": qi.name + "-RM-TC.pdf", "fcontent": pdf } ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 10. QUALITY INSPECTION LIST # -------------------------------------------------------- qi_list = ", ".join( qi_names ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 11. EMAIL SUBJECT # -------------------------------------------------------- subject = ( "RM TC - Purchase Return " + doc.name ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 12. EMAIL BODY # -------------------------------------------------------- message = ( "

Dear Team,

" "

" "Please find attached the RM TC document related to the " "below-mentioned Purchase Return and Quality Inspection for your " "reference and further necessary action." "

" "

" "Purchase Return: " + str(doc.name) + "
" "Supplier: " + str(doc.supplier) + "
" "Posting Date: " + str(doc.posting_date) + "
" "Quality Inspection: " + str(qi_list) + "

" "

" "Kindly review the attached RM TC document and proceed with the " "necessary action accordingly." "

" "

" "Should you require any further information or clarification, " "please feel free to contact us." "

" "

" "Regards,
" "Quality / Purchase Team
" "Calco" "

" ) # -------------------------------------------------------- # 13. SEND EMAIL # -------------------------------------------------------- frappe.sendmail( recipients=recipients, subject=subject, message=message, attachments=attachments )
